corq_box.title: CorQ
corq_box.text: CorQ is the final win probability for the displayed pick. Positive values support the pick, negative values go against it.

thinq_box.title: ThinQ
thinq_box.text: ThinQ shows the overall data quality behind the match analysis. It is not win probability.

pick_data_depth.title: Pick Data Depth
pick_data_depth.text: Pick Data Depth shows how strongly the available ThinQ data supports the displayed pick.

form_data_depth.title: Form Data Depth
form_data_depth.text: Form Data Depth shows the reliability of Recent Form, Surface Form and Opponent Quality data.

elo_selo.title: ELO / S-ELO
elo_selo.text: ELO is overall player strength. S-ELO is strength on the current surface. Positive values support the pick, negative values go against the pick.

h2h.title: H2H
h2h.text: Head-to-head history between the two players. Example: 1W-0L means the pick won one previous match and lost none against this opponent.

s_h2h.title: S-H2H
s_h2h.text: Surface head-to-head. This includes only previous meetings on the current surface.

thinq_edge.title: ThinQ Edge
thinq_edge.text: Combined ThinQ data edge from ELO, H2H, form, surface form, opponent quality and match dynamics.

pick_form_sform.title: Pick Form / S-Form
pick_form_sform.text: Pick Form is the pick's recent overall win-loss record. S-Form is the pick's recent record on the current surface.

opp_form_sform.title: Opp Form / S-Form
opp_form_sform.text: Opponent overall recent form and opponent recent form on the current surface.

recent_edge.title: Pick R-Edge
recent_edge.text: Recent form edge from the pick perspective. Positive supports the pick, negative goes against it.

surface_edge.title: Pick S-Edge
surface_edge.text: Surface form edge from the pick perspective. Positive supports the pick, negative goes against it.

form_quality.title: Pick Form Qty
form_quality.text: Opponent-quality adjustment for recent form. Positive supports the pick, negative goes against it.

sets_games.title: Sets / Games
sets_games.text: ThinQ match dynamics estimates: projected sets, projected games, three-set probability, score tendency and tie-break probability.

marq_box.title: MarQ
marq_box.text: MarQ is the planned market view layer. It is not fully active yet.
